{{- /* /llms.txt (llmstxt.org): the site's title and what it is, then each page of the guide in the
  sidebar's order, linking its Markdown. A top-level page or group gets a heading of its own. No
  build time is printed, so the same pages always make the same file. */ -}}
# {{ site.Title }}

> {{ site.Home.Description }}

{{ with site.GetPage "/guide" -}}
{{ index (split (.RawContent | replaceRE `^# [^\n]*\n+` "") "\n\n") 0 }}

Every page below, in one file: {{ "llms-full.txt" | absURL }}
{{- template "llms-tree" (dict "page" . "level" 2) }}
{{ end -}}

{{- define "llms-markdown" -}}
{{ with .OutputFormats.Get "markdown" }}{{ .Permalink }}{{ else }}{{ .Permalink }}{{ end }}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "llms-line" -}}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ template "llms-markdown" . }})
{{- if not .IsSection }}{{ with .Summary | plainify | htmlUnescape | strings.TrimSpace }}: {{ index (split (replace . "\n" " ") ". ") 0 }}{{ end }}{{ end }}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "llms-tree" -}}
{{- $level := .level -}}
{{- range .page.Pages.ByWeight }}
{{- if or .IsSection (eq $level 2) }}

{{ strings.Repeat $level "#" }} {{ .Title }}
{{ end }}
{{ template "llms-line" . }}
{{- if .IsSection }}{{ template "llms-tree" (dict "page" . "level" (add $level 1)) }}{{ end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end -}}
